text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for all-way stop control at the intersection of Humberview Road and Halford Avenue. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services is requesting approval to install all-way stop control at this intersection.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Humberview Road and Halford Avenue.
